entries.summary: Let followers heal themselves when safe and optionally heal allies without abandoning assigned work.
details: Follower healing rules migrate safely, combat danger blocks non-urgent treatment, and interrupted active or stashed work resumes exactly once.

entries.summary: Let followers treat registered vitamin deficiencies and prefer tolerable food while retaining a critical-starvation fallback.
Prevent invalid weapon scores and obvious empty-hand preference without changing combat coefficients or loudness rules.
